trigger: December 5, night. Augie's shack. Every frequency dies.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: December fifth. Twenty-six degrees on Peavine, frost on the towers. Augie has every radio on, every band, at once.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: Denver went quiet an hour ago. Then Omaha. Then the Navy net out of Fallon stopped mid-sentence.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Over the eastern horizon the sky turns green. Not aurora green. Wrong green. It ripples once and fades.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Every radio in the shack dies at once. The lights on the towers go out. Then the silence.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: [Into a dead handset] Galena. Galena, come in. ...Pete? Anybody?

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: High-altitude burst. Has to be. Fries anything with a chip. Galena's control racks just cooked.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: The spare transmitter's in the ammo can. Grounded. It might live. What do I tell people, Braith?

choices.text: Tell them it was a foreign attack.
Tell them the government will fix it.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: 'Something terrible happened. We don't know what. Be kind to each other.' ...God. Okay.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: Someone to blame. It'll keep them together a while. It'll also get people killed.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: 'Help is coming.' The oldest lie on the air. Fine. It's yours, not mine.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Walt sits down slowly on an ammo crate. 'Without controls, the plant is a hot rock. We need hardened spares.'
